brief:
Israeli soldiers participated in the Sydney Marathon despite protests from activists who gathered to oppose their presence, Al Jazeera English reported. The Australian government issued visas to 40 Israeli soldiers to compete in the race, a decision that drew immediate criticism from demonstrators who waved Palestinian flags at the event.

The protest reflected broader tensions over Australia's diplomatic relationship with Israel. Activists used the marathon as a focal point to voice opposition to Israeli military operations and to challenge what they characterized as the government's support for Israeli policies. The demonstration underscored ongoing divisions within Australia over the country's approach to Middle Eastern affairs and its visa policies for foreign military personnel.
dek: Protesters waved Palestinian flags and criticised the Australian government for issuing visas to 40 Israeli soldiers.
title: Israeli soldiers run Sydney Marathon amid Palestinian protests
